notes.title: A Major Update for Anathyma is now live!
notes.content:
[h3]We’re excited to drop the first [b]major update for Anathyma[/b], and it’s a big one. You can now jump into [b]online co-op[/b] with up to 8 players, unlock [b]Steam Achievements[/b], and climb the Leaderboards to show off your skills.[/h3][h3]
To make things even more fun, we’ve added a [b]character customization[/b] menu, perfect for putting your own flair on your hero in those wild multiplayer lobbies.[/h3][h3]
The interface has also been revamped, with sleeker menus, a cleaner HUD, and unit outlines that make [b]everything feel sharper and easier to read[/b].[/h3][h3]
And finally, we’ve added the [b]new Height system[/b] to gameplay. Take the high ground and gain an edge, literally, when fighting enemies from above.[/h3][h3][/h3]
